messages:
sre-bot: INCIDENT ALERT • Elevated 5xx rate detected in /api/generate - aggregated gateway errors and timeouts across us-west-2. p50 latency up 3x, p95 up 6x. auto-page: paging to oncall (tim (oncall))

elaine: seeing a big spike in 502/504 from the gateway too. dashboards show a simultaneous spike in kv prefix cache misses and CACHE_EVICT events on shard-7.

tim (oncall): ack. looking now — can someone paste the alert query?

raj: alert query: `sum(rate(http_responses_total{code=~"5..",route="/api/generate"}[1m])) by (instance)` + we correlate with `kv_prefix_cache_miss_count{shard}`.

elaine: logs from gateway show `upstream reset` and `timeout waiting for response` with backend hints: `kv-service` returning 503 occasionally.

tim (oncall): toggling verbose logs for kv-service on shard-7. enabling short-circuit to fallback model on that shard to reduce load.

ops-bot: ran: `kubectl exec -n prod kv-service-7 -- /bin/sh -c "kill -USR1 1"` (rotation signal) — logs streaming.

raj: quick theory: eviction storm + a bad prefetch job caused KV prefix cache to become inconsistent (shadowed keys), reads fall back to disk causing latencies/timeouts and cascading 5xx.

elaine: there's also a recent deploy 30m ago that changed prefetch concurrency on the prefix-loader job. rollback candidate.

tim (oncall): mitigation plan: 1) disable prefix-prefetch job globally 2) force bypass for /api/generate to cold path for 5m 3) increase kv-service replica on shard-7 to absorb backlog 4) start live dump of prefix-cache index for inspection. executing now.

raj: disabled prefetch: `helm upgrade infra-jobs --set prefixPrefetch.enabled=false` — kube job scaled down.

ops-bot: applied route override: set `route:/api/generate -> policy:cold-path` for 5m.

elaine: scaling kv-service replicas on shard-7 from 2 -> 5 to reduce queuing. `kubectl scale deploy/kv-service-7 --replicas=5 -n prod`

tim (oncall): starting cache-index dump: `kvctl dump-index --shard=7 --out=/tmp/shard7-index-$(date +%s).ndjson` — copying to internal S3 for analysis.

raj: preliminary dump shows duplicate prefix entries for ~0.7% of keys with inconsistent TTLs and a block of entries with negative hit counters -> probable corruption from recent prefetch batching edge-case.

elaine: customer impact: error rate on /api/generate peaked at 18% for a subset of requests (~region us-west-2). traffic shaping shows 12k reqs/min. core PLG customers seeing failed requests and retried clients causing extra load. opened support ticket: INC-21342.

tim (oncall): good catch. next step: apply two-pronged live mitigation — 1) run a safe index-rewrite that collapses duplicates (read-only comparator + reinsert) 2) roll back prefetch concurrency change in changelog commit c3b4. Which is faster?

raj: index-rewrite is safe but I estimate ~8 min to scan hot shard under current replica count. rollback is immediate but requires deploy pipeline gate. I'd do rollback + index-rewrite as follow-up.

elaine: rollback command: `git revert c3b4 && ./ci/deploy -e prod -s prefetch` — started, waiting for deploy to complete.

ops-bot: deploy CI started: build #6789. will post status.

sre-bot: NOTE: fallback cold-path adds ~60ms p50 and higher tokenized cost. communicate to billing/console if sustained.

tim (oncall): start temporary client throttling for heavy consumers to reduce retries. `gateway policy add-rate-limit production-heavy 2000/m`

elaine: rerouting has already dropped 5xx from 18% -> 6% in 4m, timeouts falling. good signal.

raj: index-rewrite started (background low-priority) using `kvctl repair --shard=7 --mode=collapse-duplicates --throttle=50` — will stream progress.

ops-bot: CI deploy finished: prefetch rollback deployed to prod (revision r2026).

elaine: after rollback and scaling, error rate now 1.4% and trending down. but we still see occasional 502s tied to long tail misses on other shards.

tim (oncall): handoff plan if stable by T+30: continue monitoring. if <2% and falling, demote incident to postmortem. otherwise paging for follow-up.

raj: index-rewrite progress: 35% complete, found ~14k duplicate clusters, collapsed 100% without impact, reconnecting hot keys.

elaine: customer note drafted for support: "We observed transient elevated errors affecting generation endpoints in us-west-2 caused by a prefix cache prefetch regression. We mitigated with a rollback and scaled kv-service; full index repair in progress. No data loss, reduced reliability while we triaged."

tim (oncall): OK team — great work. keep streaming logs to #incidents for 1h. switching status to "mitigated" in pagerduty. I will hand off to raj for follow-up postmortem. tagging @postmortem-runner

raj: taking handoff. will collect dump artifacts, CI diff, and root-cause timeline. next steps: add stronger validation to prefetch job, add canary on prefix index changes, add alert for duplicate-prefix-rate > 0.1% to catch earlier.

ops-bot: incident ticket updated: INC-21342 status -> mitigated.

sre-bot: final metrics: p50 latency back to normal, p95 down from 6x spike to 1.2x baseline, 5xx rate stabilized at 0.9% (baseline 0.6%). recommend postmortem within 72h.

elaine: thanks everyone. leaving notes in confluence: /docs/incidents/INC-21342-summary.

tim (oncall): signed off and ending active paging window. handoff complete. :white_check_mark:"
